Principal limitation: The passage establishes justification powerfully but does not itself determine whether justified believers require later sanctifying completion, so excluding every purgatorial model depends on the disputed relationship between standing and transformation. Live burden: White must show that Horn’s passive purification, finite consequences, and gracious rewards necessarily alter justification’s ground rather than describe consequences within an already-secured salvation.
